SubRoutine.SubRoutineName: Do Not Edit these settings directly!!, Use the 'Settings' Tab instead

Settings.Name: EmptyBagsNow
Settings.Summary: Set to true to empty bags now.

Settings.Name: SwitchToBanker
Settings.Summary: Set this to true if you want to switch to banker to AH items.

Settings.Name: DepositAllButThisAmountInGBank
Settings.Summary: Deposits all gold except this amount.

Settings.Name: DepositGoldInGbank
Settings.Summary: Set to true if you want to banker to depost gold in gbank

Settings.Name: EnableZoneTimer
Settings.Summary: Set to true to leave zone after random amount of time spent there.

Settings.Name: MinMinutesPerZone
Settings.Summary: Minimum number of minutes to spend in a zone

Settings.Name: MaxMinutesPerZone
Settings.Summary: Max number of minutes to spend in a zone

Settings.Name: RandomZones
Settings.Summary: Randomly choose next zone with current zone being excluded.

Settings.Name: DepositInGbank
Settings.Summary: deposits items in Gbank instead of mailing them to banker

Settings.Name: ProfileFolderPath
Settings.Summary: This is the path to the base profile folder. Inside are subfolders named after the zones they contain profiles for.

Settings.Name: CancelAuctions
Settings.Summary: Set to true to cancel auctions before posting on AH

Settings.Name: Max Stack Number
Settings.Summary: Max number of stacks to post on the AH

Settings.Name: Repair In Cty
Settings.Summary: Set to true if you want farmer to repair in the city

Declaration.Code: uint TotalItemsInBag() { uint cnt=0; foreach (var item in Me.BagItems cnt += item.StackCount; return cnt; }

void LoadPorfileFromSubfolder(string folder) { string path = (string)Settings["ProfileFolderPath"]; bool isAbsolute = System.IO.Path.IsPathRooted(path); if (!isAbsolute) path = System.IO.Path.Combine(Utilities.AssemblyDirectory, path); path = System.IO.Path.Combine(path, folder); path = System.IO.Path.Combine(path, Me.IsHorde ? "Horde" : "Alliance"); if (System.IO.Directory.Exists(path)) { string[] files = System.IO.Directory.GetFiles(path, "*.xml", System.IO.SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly); if (files != null && files.Length > 0) { int index = new Random().Next(0, files.Length); ProfileManager.LoadNew(files[index]); MyLog("Loading profile for zone: {0}", folder); } else Err("no profiles found in path: {0}", path); } else MyLog("ProfilePath: {0} not found", path); }
